# p10k-rs v0.2.1 — DRAFT

> Status: **draft** — pending Sean's review. Replace this banner
> and tag when ready. The release workflow fires on
> `git push origin v0.2.1`.

**The "`version --json`" release.** Single additive flag.
Brings the two scripting-oriented JSON surfaces on the
diagnostic subcommands into parity — consumers that handle
`daemon-health --json` can handle `version --json` the same
way.

**Test count:** 608 passing (unchanged; the new flag is
exercised by smoke runs).
**Slice count:** 1 commit.
**Theme:** "scripting symmetry."

## What you'll notice (visible changes)

### `p10k-rs version --json`

Pass `--json` to emit a single-line JSON object instead of the
multi-line text form. Normal case:

```json
{"binary":"0.2.1","gitstatusd_pin":"v1.5.4","triple":"x86_64-linux-gnu","binary_sha256_short":"02b7bc11a70a"}
```

Variant axes the shape covers:

- **Pinned host + entry present** — all four fields populated.
- **Pinned host without entry yet** — `triple` set,
  `binary_sha256_short` is `null`.
- **Unsupported host** — `triple` and `binary_sha256_short`
  both `null`.
- **Pins file unparseable** — `gitstatusd_pin` is `null`,
  extra `gitstatusd_error` field carries the parse-error
  message (mirrors the `daemon-health` `ERROR` variant's
  `reason` field).

`binary_sha256_short` is the first 12 hex chars of the bundled
`binary_sha256`; the full hash is via `p10k-rs verify` for
anyone who needs literal equality.

Strings get JSON-escaped via the same minimal encoder pattern
used by `daemon-health --json` (quote, backslash, C0 controls;
non-ASCII UTF-8 passes through). No new dependencies.

The text format (default) is unchanged from v0.2.0.

## Security posture (no surface changes)

- **No new dependencies.** Reuses the hand-rolled JSON-escape
  pattern from `daemon-health::json_escape` (now factored as
  a local `json_escape_str` in `main.rs`); the surface stays
  bounded so we don't pull `serde_json` for one extra line.
- **No new `unsafe`.**
- **`cargo deny check` clean.**

## Slice ledger

One commit on top of v0.2.0.

## Upgrading

```sh
git pull
./install.sh
```

No config-file migration. Existing scripts using
`p10k-rs version` (text format) continue to work unchanged.
